title: 第84章 我怕你跑了

第84章 我怕你跑了-《我发现了世界BUG》

“目标就在对面居民楼内，准备进入。”

“不清楚对方是否持有杀伤性武器，但这里靠近边境，不排除对方持有非法枪支的可能。”

“所有人检查装备，做好接敌准备。”

“明白！”

秦朗一声令下，围绕在他周围的两支特战小队立刻做出响应。

紧接着，无人机升空，开始对目标居民楼进行抵近侦察。

但很显然，对方也已经做好了应对措施。

所有门窗全部被封闭，从外围根本看不清内部的情况。

如果倒退两年，在面对这种棘手的状况时，秦朗根本无从下手，只能冒险派尖兵突入破门。

当然，这样做也必然带来人员伤亡的风险。

----但现在不一样了。

现在，这支小队配备了机器狗。

在确定无人机侦察失效后，秦朗立刻下达了第二条指令。

两只背负着步枪的机器狗同时启动，掩护着第三只携带爆破装置的机器狗上楼。

作战小队成员全部在楼下安全位置等待，一旦完成破门，他们会立刻一拥而上，在机器狗的火力掩护下冲进目标房间，把极有可能隐藏在房间内的罪魁祸首一举抓获----或者，是击毙。

秦朗盯着机器狗的操作屏幕，通过实时传回的画面，他已经看到了三楼那扇紧闭的房门。

爆破装置已经被安装在门上，只等他的起爆命令。

操作员冲他比了个大拇指，示意随时可以开始爆破。

秦朗深吸一口气，开开口下令道：

“准备突入。”

“三，二，一......”

“爆破！”

“轰！”

一声巨响。

定向炸药精准地掀翻了合金大门，紧接着，早已等待在门口的两只机械狗一冲而入！

透过热融合成像仪的视角，大量原本会对视线造成重大影响的烟雾宛如透明。

机器狗快速转向，试图寻找目标位置。

而也就在这一瞬间，在操作员还没反应过来的半秒钟内，图像识别系统已经捕捉到了闪身躲入房间内的目标。

“发现了！”

操作员一声大喝，两只机械狗瞬间加速。

紧接着，枪声响起。

“砰砰砰砰----”

子弹穿透薄薄的木门，瞬间将房门打得支离破碎。

只需要再进行一轮无差别扫射，躲在里面的目标便会顷刻暴露在密集的火力之下。

胜利仿佛就在眼前----并且，它来得相当容易。

秦朗稍稍直起身子，但并不是放松，而是警惕。

原因很简单。

在刚刚的画面中，他并没有看到“法坛”的痕迹。

没错，房间里确实存在许多可疑物体。

比如香纸、符号，以及大量不知道具体有什么功能的摆件、佛牌。

这些东西随机堆放在客厅里，似乎他们的主人正在进行什么仪式。

这样的场景充满了迷惑性，可秦朗很清楚，这绝对不是法坛。

真正的法坛，不是这样的！

这是一处陷阱----又或者说，这是一个被精心布置出来的、仅用作障眼法的假目标！

那真正的目标，会躲在哪里？

秦朗的视线快速扫过居民楼，对着无线电开口问道：

"The target is in the residential building opposite, prepare to enter."

"It's unclear whether the other party possesses anti-personnel weapons, but since it is close to the border, the possibility of the other party possessing illegal firearms cannot be ruled out."

"Everyone checks their equipment and prepares to engage the enemy."

"Understood!"

Qin Lang gave an order, and the two special operations teams surrounding him responded immediately.

Immediately afterwards, the drone took off and began to conduct close reconnaissance of the target residential building.

But obviously, the other party has also prepared countermeasures.

All doors and windows are closed, and the situation inside cannot be seen from the outside.

If we go back two years, when faced with this difficult situation, Qin Lang has no way to start and can only risk sending his top soldiers to break into the goal.

Of course, doing so will inevitably bring the risk of casualties.

----But it’s different now.

Now, the team is equipped with a robot dog.

After confirming that the drone reconnaissance failed, Qin Lang immediately issued the second order.

Two robot dogs carrying rifles were activated at the same time, covering the third robot dog carrying explosive devices going upstairs.

All members of the combat team are waiting in a safe position downstairs. Once the door is broken, they will immediately swarm forward, rush into the target room under the cover of the firepower of the robot dog, and capture the culprit who is most likely hiding in the room - or kill him in one fell swoop.

Qin Lang stared at the operating screen of the robot dog. Through the real-time transmission of the picture, he had already seen the closed door on the third floor.

The explosive device has been installed on the door, just waiting for his order to detonate.

The operator gave him a thumbs-up sign that he could start blasting at any time.

Qin Lang took a deep breath, opened his mouth and ordered:

"Prepare to break in."

"Three, two, one..."

"Explode!"

"Boom!"

There was a loud bang.

The directional explosives accurately knocked over the alloy door, and then, the two mechanical dogs that had been waiting at the door rushed in!

Through the perspective of the thermal fusion imager, a large amount of smoke that would otherwise have a significant impact on the line of sight appears to be transparent.

The robot dog turned quickly, trying to find the target location.

And at this moment, before the operator could react for half a second, the image recognition system had captured the target who had ducked into the room.

"Found it!"

The operator shouted loudly, and the two mechanical dogs accelerated instantly.

Then, gunfire rang out.

"Bang bang bang bang----"

The bullet penetrated the thin wooden door and instantly shattered it into pieces.

All it takes is one more round of indiscriminate strafing, and the target hiding inside will be instantly exposed to intensive firepower.

Victory seems to be right in front of you - and it comes easily.

Qin Lang straightened up slightly, but he was not relaxed, but alert.

The reason is simple.

In the picture just now, he saw no trace of the "Altar".

Yes, there are indeed many suspicious objects in the room.

For example, incense paper, symbols, and a large number of ornaments and Buddhist amulets whose specific functions are unknown.

These things are piled randomly in the living room, as if their owners are performing some ritual.

Such a scene is full of confusion, but Qin Lang knows very well that this is definitely not an altar.

The real altar is not like this!

This is a trap - or, in other words, this is a false target that is carefully arranged and used only as a deception!

Where will the real target be hiding?

Qin Lang's eyes quickly swept across the residential building and asked into the radio:
